name: MeetingKing
description_en:
MeetingKing is a structured meeting-agenda, minutes and task-follow-up service. It supports preparation, human-written meeting notes, assigned work and emailed minutes, rather than relying on an AI meeting recorder as its core documented workflow.

Paid organiser plans and free participant collaboration have different roles. Evaluate it with one recurring meeting and its unfinished tasks before applying it to an organisation-wide archive.
description_zh:
MeetingKing 是结构化会议议程、纪要和任务跟进服务，支持会前准备、人工记录、任务分派与邮件纪要。其核心文档流程并非依赖 AI 会议录音器。

付费组织者方案与免费参会协作承担不同角色。适合先用一次例会及其未完成任务验证，再推广到整个组织的会议档案。

core_features.explanation_en: Keep preparation and topic-based notes in one meeting workflow.
core_features.explanation_zh: 在同一会议流程中组织准备资料和分议题笔记。

core_features.explanation_en: Track follow-up tasks through the task overview.
core_features.explanation_zh: 通过任务总览跟踪会议后续工作。

core_features.explanation_en: Free participant accounts can comment and update tasks.
core_features.explanation_zh: 免费参与者账户可评论和更新任务。

en: Prepare agendas and retain human-reviewed minutes.
Carry outstanding tasks into the next meeting.
zh: 准备议程并保留人工审核纪要。
将未完成任务带入下次会议。
use_cases.basis: Illustrative selection guidance; no customer outcome or hands-on claim.

Deployment.en: Vendor-hosted web service; official manual hosted on Manula.
Deployment.zh: 厂商托管网页服务；官方手册托管在 Manula。

steps.en: Create one meeting with agenda topics and participants.
steps.zh: 创建一次会议，设置议题和参与者。

steps.en: Record decisions and assign tasks, then review emailed minutes.
steps.zh: 记录决策、分派任务，再检查邮件纪要。

steps.en: Use a follow-up meeting and inspect outstanding tasks before wider adoption.
steps.zh: 用后续会议检查未完成任务，再决定是否扩大使用。

items.en: The security page describes vendor hosting and daily encrypted system backups, with older infrastructure terminology. These are vendor statements, not a current audit or a customer-controlled restore guarantee. For missing minutes or a failed task export, retain the source notes, inspect destination state and contact support before repeating changes. It fits structured human-led meetings; teams needing automatic transcripts, verified modern identity controls or self-hosting need additional evidence. No open-source licence was verified.
items.zh: 安全页说明厂商托管与每日加密系统备份，并使用较旧的基础设施术语。这是厂商陈述，不是当前审计或客户自主恢复保证。纪要缺失或任务导出失败时，建议保留原始笔记、核对目标状态，重复修改前联系支持。它适合结构化人工主持会议；若需要自动转录、已验证的现代身份控制或自行部署，还需补充证据。未核实开源许可。

pricing.billing_basis: Organiser-user bundle monthly; participant accounts have separate free scope.
pricing.source_snapshot_zh: 月费单用户 9.95、五用户 39.95、十用户 64.95、25 用户 124.95。试用时长未确认。

sections.title_en: Turn an agenda into minutes and follow-up
sections.title_zh: 把议程变成纪要与跟进
sections.en: For an illustrative committee meeting, prepare topics before the call, take notes under each topic, assign owners to resulting tasks and email the minutes afterwards. The official manual documents follow-up meetings, parking-lot items, project/department tags and task overviews. Keep a decision and its task owner distinct: a note about a proposal does not establish that someone accepted responsibility. MeetingKing can accompany a face-to-face or online call; it does not replace the call service.
sections.zh: 例如召开委员会会议时，先准备议题，会议中在各议题下记录，再为产生的任务分配负责人，会后发送邮件纪要。官方手册列有后续会议、暂存议题、项目／部门标签与任务总览。应区分决策与任务负责人：记录了提案，不代表有人接受责任。MeetingKing 可配合线下或线上会议，不替代通话服务。

sections.title_zh: 付费组织者与免费参与者
sections.en: The plans page says participants do not need an account to be included. They can create a free account to collaborate, comment and update tasks. This should not be presented as a free organiser plan with all paid capabilities. The site documents Zapier task export, but some homepage examples name older third-party services; check the live connector and destination action before treating a named integration as currently usable.
sections.zh: 套餐页说明参与会议不要求账户；参与者可注册免费账户，协作、评论并更新任务。这不能写成拥有全部付费功能的免费组织者套餐。官网列有通过 Zapier 导出任务，但首页部分示例使用旧第三方服务名；应核查当前连接器和目标动作，再判断具体集成能否使用。

sections.title_zh: 组织者组合与取消条件
sections.en: Monthly prices shown are $9.95 for one user/1 GB, $39.95 for five users/5 GB, $64.95 for ten/10 GB and $124.95 for 25/25 GB. They list unlimited meetings, templates, Google Calendar integration and unlimited archive period. Trial links are provided but the retrieved page does not state duration or card requirements. Cancellation stops renewal at the end of the paid period; annual alternative payment methods are arranged by contact. Regional currency/tax treatment was not verified.
sections.zh: 页面列出的月费为单用户／1 GB 9.95，五用户／5 GB 39.95，十用户／10 GB 64.95，25 用户／25 GB 124.95。均列有不限会议、模板、Google Calendar 集成与不限归档期限。页面有试用入口，但读取内容未说明时长或信用卡要求。取消后在已付周期结束时停止续订；年度其他付款方式需联系安排。未核实地区币种／税务处理。

research_gaps.zh: 未核实试用时长、当前基础设施控制、真实 Zapier 兼容性与恢复／导出行为。
